package postgres

import (
	"context"

	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain"
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain/repository"
	"github.com/jackc/pgx/v5"
	"github.com/jackc/pgx/v5/pgxpool"
)

// CourseI18nRepoPG implements CourseI18nRepository.
type CourseI18nRepoPG struct {
	Pool *pgxpool.Pool
}

// Upsert inserts or updates course localization.
func (r CourseI18nRepoPG) Upsert(ctx context.Context, entry domain.CourseI18n) error {
	courseID := entry.CourseID
	runner := getRunner(ctx, r.Pool)
	_, err := runner.Exec(ctx, `INSERT INTO course_i18n (course_id, i18n_id, title, description)
VALUES ($1,$2,$3,$4)
ON CONFLICT (course_id, i18n_id) DO UPDATE SET title=EXCLUDED.title, description=EXCLUDED.description`,
		courseID, entry.I18nID, entry.Title, entry.Description)
	return err
}

// GetByCourseAndLang returns localization for course by language with fallback.
func (r CourseI18nRepoPG) GetByCourseAndLang(ctx context.Context, courseID string, lang string) (*domain.CourseI18n, error) {
	runner := getRunner(ctx, r.Pool)
	row := runner.QueryRow(ctx, `
WITH lang AS (
    SELECT id FROM i18n WHERE language = $2
)
SELECT ci.course_id, ci.i18n_id, ci.title, ci.description
FROM course_i18n ci
LEFT JOIN lang l ON TRUE
WHERE ci.course_id = $1
ORDER BY (ci.i18n_id = l.id) DESC, ci.i18n_id
LIMIT 1
`, courseID, lang)
	var entry domain.CourseI18n
	if err := row.Scan(&entry.CourseID, &entry.I18nID, &entry.Title, &entry.Description); err != nil {
		if err == pgx.ErrNoRows {
			return nil, domain.ErrNotFound
		}
		return nil, err
	}
	return &entry, nil
}

// ListByCourse returns all localizations for a course.
func (r CourseI18nRepoPG) ListByCourse(ctx context.Context, courseID string) ([]domain.CourseI18n, error) {
	runner := getRunner(ctx, r.Pool)
	rows, err := runner.Query(ctx, `
SELECT course_id, i18n_id, title, description
FROM course_i18n
WHERE course_id = $1
ORDER BY i18n_id`, courseID)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	defer rows.Close()

	result := []domain.CourseI18n{}
	for rows.Next() {
		var entry domain.CourseI18n
		if err := rows.Scan(&entry.CourseID, &entry.I18nID, &entry.Title, &entry.Description); err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		result = append(result, entry)
	}
	if rows.Err() != nil {
		return nil, rows.Err()
	}
	return result, nil
}

// CountByCourse returns number of localizations for a course.
func (r CourseI18nRepoPG) CountByCourse(ctx context.Context, courseID string) (int, error) {
	runner := getRunner(ctx, r.Pool)
	var count int
	if err := runner.QueryRow(ctx, `SELECT COUNT(*) FROM course_i18n WHERE course_id=$1`, courseID).Scan(&count); err != nil {
		return 0, err
	}
	return count, nil
}

// DeleteByCourse removes localization entry.
func (r CourseI18nRepoPG) DeleteByCourse(ctx context.Context, courseID string, i18nID int) error {
	runner := getRunner(ctx, r.Pool)
	cmd, err := runner.Exec(ctx, `DELETE FROM course_i18n WHERE course_id=$1 AND i18n_id=$2`, courseID, i18nID)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if cmd.RowsAffected() == 0 {
		return domain.ErrNotFound
	}
	return nil
}

var _ repository.CourseI18nRepository = (*CourseI18nRepoPG)(nil)
